patch.value: Map typed work item relations onto pm parent and dependency kinds in both directions

Azure DevOps relations are typed rather than free-form: Parent, Child, Related, Duplicate, Predecessor and Successor each carry meaning the pm model already has a home for. Parent and Child map onto pm hierarchy, and the remaining kinds map onto pm dependency kinds. Round-tripping them preserves structure that a flat field-only sync would discard, and it is what lets a project imported from Azure DevOps still answer a pm graph query.
Each relation kind round-trips without loss; a cycle introduced remotely is refused rather than written into the local hierarchy; an unmapped relation kind is reported rather than silently dropped

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Audit 2026-09-13: EXISTS — mapRelations (index.ts line 506) maps all six ADO relation kinds to pm kinds via RELATION_MAP (parent, child, related, duplicate, blocked_by, blocks); unmapped relation kinds are reported in the unmapped array rather than silently dropped, tested in test/ado.test.ts. REMAINS — only the ADO-to-pm read direction is implemented; there is no pm-to-ADO reverse mapping for writes (buildUpdatePatch handles fields only, not relations), so relations do not round-trip. No cycle detection or refusal exists: a cycle introduced remotely would be written into the local hierarchy without refusal. Both missing pieces are required by the acceptance criteria.
